goals: ML model approach for diagnosis suggestion (must be explainable)
constraints: - Regulatory: must comply with FDA Software as Medical Device (SaMD) guidance
- Deployment: on-premise at hospital data centers (no cloud allowed for PHI)
All predictions must include confidence scores and contributing factors
Must handle missing data gracefully (EHR data is notoriously incomplete)
Latency: suggestions must appear within 3 seconds during patient encounter
Must include audit trail for every suggestion
context_facts: I'm building a clinical decision support system for primary care physicians. The system will analyze patient records and suggest potential diagnoses and recommended tests.
You are not a medical professional and neither am I
meta_requirements: Clearly distinguish between technical recommendations and clinical judgments
Flag any area where a clinical advisor should review your suggestions
Do not make claims about clinical efficacy
